factual_methodology.summary: Verified primary reporting dates and statistical universes: FAO SOFI 2026 or WHO GLASS 2025 and WOAH 2025, UNEP and treaty oversight as applicable.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Full bilingual texts checked for unit, date, mechanism and visual parity; new reports meet substantive depth checks. End-of-article bibliographies and in-text numbered references checked for both languages.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two numeric charts, multiple tables, causal flow and qualitative geography per locale; numeric series compared exactly.

research_depth.summary: Full causal, political economy, distributional, uncertainty, policy comparison and falsifiability sections.

evidence_traceability.summary: At least eight distinct URLs and four source domains per locale; source claims tied to primary institutional releases. Primary sources presented in final reference lists rather than dispersed inline URLs.

counterfactual_review.summary: Explicit rival interpretations, falsifying evidence and measurement limitations.

contrary_evidence: Healthful diet costs rose while estimated inability to afford a diet fell; cost alone is insufficient.
Hunger, food insecurity, foodborne illness and healthy-diet affordability have different denominators.
limitations: Editorial review and deterministic source/visual checks are not external scientific peer review.
Observational associations do not establish causal attribution.
Cross-country sources differ in reference periods and data coverage.
notes: Editorial/source and cross-language QA completed during this publication transaction; no claim of independent external peer review. GitHub Actions will additionally check the canonical site build. Formatting revision: reference URLs moved exclusively to final bibliography; numbered in-text citations synchronized across EN/PT-BR, with corrections of outdated links. No outside scientific peer-review claim.

en.title: The cost of a healthy diet and the economics of development
en.deck: Food output does not guarantee healthy diets. FAO's 2026 price and affordability findings reveal the roles of income, logistics, childhood nutrition, food safety and public institutions.
en.regime: Improving global affordability despite rising healthy-diet costs, with major distributional and regional gaps.
en.key_risk: High production or cheaper calories fail to translate into safe, nutritious diets for low-income households.

pt-BR.title: O custo de uma dieta saudável e a economia do desenvolvimento
pt-BR.deck: A produção agrícola não garante nutrição. Os dados de 2026 da FAO mostram o papel da renda, logística, saúde infantil, inocuidade alimentar e capacidade institucional.
pt-BR.regime: Melhora da acessibilidade global apesar do aumento do custo das dietas saudáveis e grandes diferenças regionais.
pt-BR.key_risk: Produção elevada ou calorias baratas não asseguram dietas seguras e nutritivas para famílias com renda restrita.
